generate_vsprojects_from_libs_and_target: run mako_plugin to generate vsprojects and vsproject_dict from a dictionary of libs and targets
generate_vs_project_guid: generate an MD5-based Visual Studio project GUID for a Windows target using mako_plugin
annotate_targets_with_vs_config_type: annotate build targets with vs_config_type like Application or StaticLibrary via mako_plugin
filter_projects_by_language_and_build: filter projects by language and build type such as test or private using mako_plugin
create_vspackages_dict: create a vspackages_dict mapping package names to package entries via mako_plugin
